articles.title: Microsoft feared being too dependent on OpenAI, Musk-Altman trial testimony reveals
articles.description: Top Microsoft executives testified in Musk v. Altman this week, spelling out concerns they had in the early days of the partnership with OpenAI.

articles.title: Hamas must disarm, not ‘disappear’ from Gaza: Board of Peace’s Mladenov
articles.description: 'We are not asking Hamas to disappear as a political movement’, says diplomat overseeing the US-brokered truce in Gaza.

articles.title: Thief jailed after stealing unreleased Beyoncé music from car
articles.description: The man smashed into a car and stole luggage containing hard drives with the singer's tracks.

articles.title: South Carolina court tosses murder conviction in Alex Murdaugh case
articles.description: The state's high court ruled that Murdaugh was denied a fair trial due to comments from a court clerk suggesting guilt.

articles.title: Trump-Xi summit: China’s help in Iran may require US concessions
articles.description: Analysts say China may seek changes in US policy towards Taiwan if it were to pressure Iran to reopen Hormuz.

articles.title: Hormuz closure cuts OPEC oil production by 30% and threatens demand growth this year, cartel says
articles.description: Global demand is facing constraints because supply from the Persian Gulf has been effectively cut off by Iran's blockade of the Strait of the Hormuz.

articles.title: Court overturns Alex Murdaugh's murder convictions and orders new trial
articles.description: The court has ordered a new trial over the June 2021 killings of Paul and Maggie Murdaugh.
